label: Extracted WIRING parasitics of the 4-row x 4-column arrays, compact layouts (#100) vs the uniform grid (#80). Wiring only: diffusion-junction and gate capacitance are not included. Not a macro-level number; 4 rows only.
convention: total_ff = ground_ff + sum(coupled[].capacitance_ff) per net, as array_parasitics.net_entry / derive_retention.load_extracted_c_sn(). Lateral coupling covers pairs touching a --critical-net; for the compact layouts that includes the anonymous storage-node nets (--critical-net-pattern '\$*'), so the comparison is like-for-like.
klt_version_note: The uniform-grid extraction was made with klt 0.7.0; re-extracting it with the klt used for the compact layouts reproduced every net's total capacitance and resistance exactly.

extractor_reported.model: klt lumped STAR: resistance_ohm = sum of per-gate-terminal leg resistances to a hub (rc_model=lumped); NOT an end-to-end line resistance
